title: Stop waiting for the right time
summary: This meets the delaying mind that honors practice in theory and postpones it in life. The line asks a sharp question: if not now, when does remembrance begin?
lifeApplication: Before reorganizing the morning again, sit where you are and say the line once. Let devotion start in the actual minute instead of the ideal one.

source.shortMeaning: The right time appears only when remembrance begins now.
source.lifeApplication: When you postpone practice, start with one faithful minute before planning more.

evidence.coreClaim: The right time appears only when remembrance begins now.
evidence.turn: Remembrance becomes true when it stops waiting for later.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before reorganizing the morning again, sit where you are and say the line once. Let devotion start in the actual minute instead of the ideal one.
